name: Mission on Integrated Development of Horticulture- NHM and HMNEH
benefit:
> **Production and Productivity Improvement:**

- Assistance for adoption of improved technologies and quality planting material.
- Support for area expansion under improved horticulture crop varieties.
- Support for rejuvenation and replacement of old and unproductive plantations.

> **Quality Planting Material:**

- Assistance for establishment and upgradation of nurseries.
- Support for product
_eligibility_text: > The following categories of beneficiaries are eligible to receive assistance under various components of the scheme: - Individual Farmers - Farmer-Producer Organizations (FPOs) - Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs) - Self-Help Groups (SHGs) - Cooperative Societies - Partnership Firms - Proprietary Firms - Companies - Corporations - Local Bodies - Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs) - State Government Entities (for eligible components)
